newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Legato Systems cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Legato Systems cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it cut its rating on shares of Legato Systems Inc to buy from strong buy.

-- In a statement, the investment research firm's analyst Chris Galvin said the rating cut was "in expectation of outperformance coming in the second half of 1997 versus the March and June 1997 quarters."
-- Galvin noted the company has a strong up-market product pipeline in the second half, and its growing direct sales force is aiming at larger accounts.
-- He also noted some near term transition concerns as the company begins to roll-out new product initiatives.
